# Mozart

> AI coding agent manager. Mozart runs a team of Claude Code agents in parallel, each isolated in its own Workspace, so you can review and merge their work like any other contributor.

Home: https://mozart.build

## Docs - Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://mozart.build/docs/introduction): What Mozart is, how it works, and when to use it.
- [Install](https://mozart.build/docs/install): Get the Mozart desktop app on your machine.
- [Quickstart](https://mozart.build/docs/quickstart): From install to a reviewed diff in five steps.

## Docs - Concepts

- [Isolated workspaces](https://mozart.build/docs/concepts/isolated-workspaces): How Mozart keeps parallel Agent Runs from stepping on each other.
- [Local first](https://mozart.build/docs/concepts/local-first): Your code stays on your machine. The cloud is opt-in, not default.
- [Settings](https://mozart.build/docs/concepts/settings): How Mozart layers defaults, your machine, and per-project settings.

## Docs - Community

- [We are mozart](https://mozart.build/docs/community/we-are-mozart): Where to find us, ask questions, and contribute.

## Blog

- [Hello, World](https://mozart.build/blog/hello-world): Why I am building Mozart, a conductor for AI coding agents.
